name: ideas
description: Owner requirement 2026-10-27: when a user has no idea, every area proposes striking, fitting directions at once from Studio's own knowledge, then searches if needed. Run with --suite ideas. PB cases (real-use report 2026-10-30): a user with a precise concept gets it executed, with any additions only as labelled optional suggestions.

cases.title: Motion graphics with no idea

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Potrzebuję krótkiej animacji motion graphics na Instagram dla schroniska dla zwierząt, które zbiera karmę przed zimą. Nie mam pomysłu, zaproponuj coś.

rubric: Gives two or three concrete, striking directions at once, built from this brief and different in mechanism
Uses the owning skill's own knowledge (library, examples, methods) before generic advice
Asks at most one question, after the directions

cases.title: A vertical ad pitches concepts with a named wow moment before building

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Zrób pionową reklamę 9:16 dla lokalnej lemoniadziarni. Ma zatrzymać scrollowanie, nie mam pomysłu.

rubric: Gives two or three concepts, each with its wow moment in the first second named
Tests each against why someone would stop scrolling for this business
Plans one board where the object or a word fills about 70% of the 9:16 frame and names the biggest change
Does not build before the user picks

cases.title: Precise poster concept is executed, not replaced

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Napisz mi prompt do generatora obrazów. Plakat koncertu jazzowego: czarne tło, na środku złoty saksofon, z którego wylatują nuty zamieniające się w ptaki. U góry napis "Jazz nad Wisłą", na dole "12.12, Klub Pod Mostem". Styl art deco, tylko czerń i złoto. Pionowo, A3.

rubric: Executes the user's concept as given: saxophone, notes turning into birds, art deco, black and gold, the exact copy
Does not propose alternative directions or swap the motif
Any own additions come after the prompt, under a clear optional label, at most three, with a question whether to add them

cases.title: Precise motion concept keeps the user's mechanism

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Rozpisz mi storyboard 10-sekundowej animacji na Reels dla piekarni "Złoty Kłos". Mam gotowy pomysł: kłos zboża rośnie od dołu kadru, zamienia się w bochenek chleba, bochenek się kroi i z przekroju wychodzi logo piekarni, na końcu napis "Codziennie od 6:00". Ciepłe brązy, bez muzyki.

rubric: Keeps the user's mechanism (wheat grows, becomes a loaf, the cut reveals the logo) and their copy, colours and no music
Does not replace the idea with a library or gallery mechanism or offer competing directions
Own suggestions, if any, are separate, labelled optional and asked about, not built into the storyboard

cases.title: Precise video shot gets red flags and unscripted motion

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Napisz prompt do Kling 3.0, 5 sekund. Zbliżenie z góry: dłonie baristy nalewają spienione mleko do espresso i rysują serce latte art. Na białym kubku czarny napis "Poranek". Ciepłe poranne światło z okna.

rubric: Keeps the user's shot (overhead close-up, barista hands, latte art heart, white cup, warm window light)
Flags the generator risks it sees (readable text on the cup, hands and pouring, the heart forming) as labelled red flags with the smallest fix, without silently changing the shot
Anchors the key action and end state and describes the motion's feel instead of scripting every move
